box_semantics: Same fixed spatial region as the displayed old rectangle, not a tracked object or the entire frame.
coordinates_basis: Measured core blue border bands in the old JPG, rounded to fixed centerline bounds; exact old renderer and subpixel boundary not recovered.
blue_mask_used_for_measurement: B>170 and B-R>120 and B-G>100; no content-based target selection
stroke_placement: Outer strips adjoining ROI; image-edge strips are clipped into the outermost 3 pixels. No filled overlay inside ROI.
number_patch_reference: ROI top-left; outside ROI to the left, fixed across the clip
save_format: PNG RGB lossless without video/time/source metadata
historical_differences: Measured fixed bounds rather than recovered historical renderer coordinates
